category: debrid resale - Indonesian agent that upgrades the buyer's account by hand

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
binding_note: The seller must hold the buyer's credentials to deliver at all, and the vendor records connections: the delivery itself is the sharing event the terms describe.
confidence_note: the seller's page was read; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. Four terms offered (30 / 90 / 180 / 365 days) with the price printed as 'Rp Call.000' - i.e. by quotation, no number published.
free_tier.notes: the page's own notice: 'Sistem Payment produk ini belum otomatis, pelanggan harus mengirimkan userlogin dan password untuk kami upgrade secara manual. Estimasi waktu upgrade 1 s/d 48 jam'

egress.terms: no byte allowance published; the page sells 'download speed unlimited' as a vendor feature

limits.value: manual upgrade, 1-48 h on working days, after the buyer sends username and password
the seller logs in from Indonesia to perform the upgrade; the buyer logs in from elsewhere

identity_cost.detail: local Indonesian bank transfer (ATM, mobile banking, e-banking), no card and no PayPal; the order is completed over the shop's own channel

reliability_note: Handing the seller the account password is the failure: the vendor's new-location check emails a PIN to the account's mailbox, and a login from the seller's IP is exactly the pattern its terms suspend.

evidence.proved: the manual-upgrade notice requiring username and password, the 1-48 h window, 'Rp Call.000' placeholders, and the nine-year trading claim

'The User's account is for personal use only. Only the individual who holds the account is allowed to connect on it. Connections to the User's account are recorded so that we can detect account sharing.' and 'Any account sharing or generated links sharing will lead to a suspension of the User account.' and 'not allowed to resell any Premium account nor managing it for somebody else without our explicit permission'

notes: The only shop found whose delivery method requires the buyer's password. That makes it the clearest case of the category: the resale is not of days but of access, and access is what the vendor's identity checks are built to stop.
